definitionZh: CSS 属性控件,在它所应用的元素的文字内容中,使用绑定形式和上下文形式。 这导致由此产生的案文形式更加统一。
sourceDefinition: The font-variant-ligatures CSS property controls which ligature and contextual forms are used in the textual content of the elements it applies to. This leads to more harmonized forms in the resulting text.
